description: This file defines the RedisEventPublisher class which implements the IServerSideEventStreamer interface. It manages Redis client connection, event listeners, and provides methods to publish various server-side events related to chat interactions, such as start, token, source documents, artifacts, tools, metadata, TTS events, and errors.

classes.name: RedisEventPublisher
classes.description: A class that manages Redis client connection and publishes various chat-related events to Redis channels.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Redis client based on environment variables and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Sets up Redis client event handlers for connect, ready, error, end, and reconnecting events.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the Redis client is ready.

methods.name: streamCustomEvent
methods.description: Publishes a custom event with specified chatId, eventType, and data.

methods.name: streamAgentFlowExecutedDataEvent
methods.description: Publishes an agent flow executed data event.

methods.name: streamNextAgentFlowEvent
methods.description: Publishes a next agent flow event.

methods.name: streamMetadataEvent
methods.description: Publishes metadata event with optional fields from apiResponse.
